imageScope: Forward-only automatic processing of new eligible incoming images with persistent runtime derivatives and dynamic frontend delivery. No historical image backfill.

historicalBatch.preservation: Preserve existing originals and recovery backups; removal from intended release is not permission to delete them.

retainedOptimizations: Incidental map deferral and camera lifecycle
Pure waypoint imports and intent-based Home map warming
Verified failed-download housekeeping with originals preserved
historicalEvidencePolicy: Prior static-batch evidence was superseded. Current evidence files describe fresh tests of the forward-only candidate, not historical image savings.

publication.repair: Test-only screenshot capture reliability adjustment plus plan authorization hold; no application runtime changes.
publication.scopeLimit: Live identity and successful deployment pipeline; publisher/member mutation workflows were verified locally with disposable databases, not repeated against production.
publication.nextGate: Release5a separately, then5b, then stop for review. Release6and7 require explicit approval.

limitations: No physical iPhone/Safari proof from earlier cloud checks.
Offline metrics cannot establish live whole-page speed; request routing disables HTTP cache.

implementationDesign.queue: Persistent SQLite event jobs and future insert/poster/publication/privacy-change triggers, installed after seed. No new processor backfill scan. Existing remote-poster mirroring around15seconds after startup can change old remote URLs to local, triggering legitimate replacement optimization.
implementationDesign.eligibility: Current event LIVE, public, not private, same source URL.
implementationDesign.processing: Local first-party files only; at most 2 sequential jobs per 5-second tick; 20 MiB/40 MP; 3 total attempts; WebP q88 widths640/1280 no upscale and at least5% byte reduction.
implementationDesign.storage: Persistent sibling of uploads, outside static serving; current eligibility checked by metadata/image endpoints with private,no-store.
implementationDesign.frontend: Shared EventFlyerArt/EventModal query; one30-second foreground refresh timer; eligible first-party cold images wait at most2seconds, then original fallback. External/paused-offline bypass wait. Metadata limited to5000newestready records/2MB; omitted mappings use originals.
limits: Old unchanged events are not scanned; future publication/poster changes, including existing mirroring, may qualify.
External URLs remain original-only unless existing ingestion captures them locally.
Same-URL byte replacement does not automatically invalidate outputs.
No claimed aggregate disk cap or orphan cleanup.
Already delivered bytes cannot be recalled.

focusedEvidence.posterBrowser: pass: DPR1/2/3, fallback and five cold-metadata cases; 400ms ready had zero original requests, error/timeout/empty/paused-offline had one original request each.
focusedEvidence.ingestionPipeline: Publisher14checks/member13checks passed through actual HTTP routes and real background timer with copied databases, loopback-only traffic and preserved originals.
